scope: Project create/save/move/reopen, missing-asset repair, export failure and cancellation through the production QML; crash recovery and interrupted saves by reference
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none, Qt offscreen platform
verified_behaviors: Import, level edits, Save and a float32 two-bar export through typed paths and clicks; the export is decoded by the test's own reader
Moving the project folder: Open reports the audio found inside the project folder, leaves the change unsaved (a second Open is refused until Save) and exports identical samples
Deleted audio opens as 'Missing: loop.wav' with a status message; Relink to a copy elsewhere restores identical samples
Export onto an existing file is refused with that file byte-identical; export into a missing folder fails with no file; document and Undo history unchanged
Cancel during a 64-bar export leaves neither the file nor a .part file
Saving the repair and opening it in a fresh session and window exports identical samples
By reference: autosaveAndCrashRecovery restores through the banner after a real abort; atomic-save-faults covers fault-injected and killed saves
limits: Offscreen Qt platform with synthetic input; native Wayland input, file dialogs and physical audio remain unqualified (#22).
